history_policy: strictly before origin; refresh observed history; no refit or calibration update
history_mask: existing training-only modelling_start; excludes 484 leading rows across 10 SKUs; SKU 21166 starts 2009-12-07
uncertainty_label: experimental empirical historical-error daily prediction intervals
interval_rule: max(0, point + original-training SKU/horizon-week residual quantile); no rounding or forced point containment
zero_denominators: WAPE/relative bias undefined if zero actual total; any zero training scale makes macro MASE undefined; no epsilon or dropped products
missing_intervals: explicit missing counts; aggregate coverage/width/score undefined if any missing; no substitution
interval_score: width + 2/alpha times distance outside bounds; alpha=0.20 or 0.05
sku_comparison: MASE weekday_mean versus fixed seasonal_naive; tie absolute difference <=1e-10; descriptive only
dependence: 28000 origin-specific instances repeat 9100 SKU/date pairs; overlapping horizons/histories dependent; no independent-sample significance claims
repeat_policy: verify complete saved artifacts and report; refuse overwrite or reevaluation; incomplete started runs require explicit documented defect handling
known_validation_limitations: weekday mean macro MASE 0.7581087857; WAPE 97.17603956%; substantial absolute error
95% mean width 149.70915324 units; wide bands do not demonstrate inventory value
pooled weekdays, overlapping residuals and serial dependence; distribution-shift risk
observed sales are not uncensored demand or verified availability; no aggregate/joint coverage guarantee
